scenes.basis: 19:1 "He entered and was passing through Jericho"; 19:2 "a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector"
19:11 "he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem" - the parable is told while leaving Jericho (19:1), before "he went on ahead" (19:28)

19:29 "he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet"; 19:30 "Go your way into the village on the other side" - the colt is found in Bethsphage and the procession begins (19:36-38)
19:41 "he saw the city and wept over it"
19:45 "He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it"
